caveats: Exploratory synthetic validation evidence; final tests remain unopened.
Model selection reuses validation; comparison intervals do not correct selection or multiplicity.
Ledger/component arithmetic is independently checked; fitted predictions use the recorded regression implementation.
Principal, settlement P&L and haircut are outside the friction target.
Costs are fixed synthetic estimates, not observed charges.
Version one excludes broker pending allocation reserves from financing; this is a partial venue-friction target. Final testing is on hold pending correction.
interpretation: Two cost MLP seeds ran 80 epochs. Validation RMSEs 0.09514 and 0.09739 virtual USD versus ridge 0.16241 and quoted full-fill control 0.17703 across 95 source groups. Neural seed11 was selected by the preregistered validation criterion. Final tests remain unopened; no policy/economic or real-market benefit is established.
next_experiment: Correct financing to include broker pending allocation reserves, version the target, and rebuild/retrain before independent evaluation.

limitations: Exploratory synthetic validation evidence; final tests remain unopened.
Model selection reuses validation; comparison intervals do not correct selection or multiplicity.

selection.criterion: Minimum mean validation source-group RMSE by family; prefer ridge within 0.005 virtual USD RMSE. Representative seed has minimum validation RMSE. No policy promotion.

title: Neural model reduced synthetic friction error on validation
